Appearance

Stocky, barrel-chested man with a shaved head and thick red beard braided with iron rings. Tower shield on his back at all times.

What We Know

Captain of the King's Guard. Has served since King Alaric's coronation. Never far from the king's side. Fiercely protective.

First Impressions

Voice like gravel in a barrel. Watches every doorway like he expects trouble.
